followups.action: Confirm the patient is on medical therapy or lifestyle changes for glucose control (the note lists metformin 1000 mg twice daily).
followups.why: The criterion asks for ongoing glucose-management therapy; the record names a drug but not the regimen's status.

followups.action: Order a spot urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) at screening.
followups.why: The trial needs UACR 500 to 5000 mg/g; no UACR is in the patient facts.

followups.action: Use the same screening UACR result (repeat if the first is borderline).
followups.why: Second UACR criterion with the same 500 to 5000 mg/g range.

followups.action: Ask the nephrologist whether any non-diabetic kidney disease has been diagnosed or suspected (e.g., biopsy, glomerulonephritis).
followups.why: Excludes non-diabetic renal disease; the note does not say.

followups.action: Ask whether the patient has ever had immunosuppressive treatment (steroids, rituximab, etc.) for a kidney condition.
followups.why: Excludes renal disease treated with systemic immunosuppression; not documented.

followups.action: Confirm the patient has never been on chronic dialysis and has no kidney transplant.
followups.why: Excludes end-stage kidney disease on dialysis or transplant; eGFR 48 makes it unlikely but it is not stated.

followups.action: Ask about any hospital stay over 24 hours in recent months; the investigator also judges medical stability.
followups.why: Excludes medically unstable patients or recent hospitalization; not in the record.

coordinator_email.subject: Possible participant for NCT07271186 (ALN-ANG3 in diabetic kidney disease)
coordinator_email.body:
Hello,

I am referring a 61-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and stage 3a CKD who may fit NCT07271186. He meets the age, diagnosis, HbA1c (8.4%) and eGFR (48) criteria. Still open: UACR (we will order one), and confirmation that he has no non-diabetic kidney disease, no prior immunosuppression for kidney disease, no dialysis or transplant, and no recent hospitalization.

Could you tell me the nearest active site and the next steps for pre-screening?

Thank you.

patient_summary.en: There is a research study for people with type 2 diabetes and kidney disease. You may be a good fit. First, we need a simple urine test and a few answers about your kidney health. A study nurse may call you. Taking part is your choice.
patient_summary.es: Hay un estudio de investigación para personas con diabetes tipo 2 y enfermedad de los riñones. Usted podría calificar. Primero necesitamos una prueba sencilla de orina y algunas respuestas sobre la salud de sus riñones. Una enfermera del estudio podría llamarle. Participar es su decisión.
